blocks.text: Sifat + predlog: afraid of, good at, interested in

Ingliz tilida ko'p sifatlar o'zidan keyin **ma'lum bir predlog** talab qiladi: afraid **of**, good **at**, interested **in**, angry **with**, married **to**. O'zbekchada bu vazifani kelishik qo'shimchalari bajaradi: it**lardan** qo'rqaman, tarix**ga** qiziqaman, matematika**ni** yaxshi bilaman. Muammo shundaki, o'zbekcha qo'shimcha inglizcha predlogga **mos kelmaydi**: «-dan qo'rqmoq» — afraid **of** (from emas), «-ga qiziqmoq» — interested **in** (to emas), «bilan turmush qurmoq» — married **to** (with emas). Shuning uchun sifat va predlogni **bitta birikma** sifatida yodlash kerak.

rows: afraid / scared **of**, proud **of**, tired **of**, full **of**, jealous **of**, fond **of**
...dan qo'rqmoq, ...bilan faxrlanmoq, ...dan charchamoq, ...ga to'la, ...ga hasad qilmoq, ...ni yaxshi ko'rmoq
...dan jahli chiqmoq / xavotirlanmoq / xafa bo'lmoq / hayajonlanmoq, ... uchun uzr

blocks.text: **of** ko'pincha his-tuyg'u sifatlari bilan keladi: afraid **of** the dark, proud **of** your children, tired **of** the noise, jealous **of** somebody. **full of** — «... ga to'la». **at** — mahorat: good **at** chess, bad **at** sport. **in** — qiziqish: interested **in** art. **on** — yoqtirish: keen **on** football (British English). Diqqat: «good **in** English» emas, **good at** English.

items.text: Our teacher is very **proud of** her students.
Are you **good at** chess? — Not bad.

blocks.text: **angry** ikki xil predlog oladi: kishiga nisbatan — angry **with** somebody (Aziz**dan** jahli chiqdi), narsa yoki voqeaga nisbatan — angry **about** something (kechikish**dan** jahli chiqdi). **about** bilan yana: worried, upset, excited, sorry **about**. **for** — sabab, maqsad: famous **for** silk, late **for** work, ready **for** the exam, responsible **for** the project. **to** — kimgadir yo'nalgan munosabat: kind **to**, nice **to**, married **to**, similar **to**. **different from** — o'zbekchadagi «-dan farq qiladi» ga mos keladigan kamdan-kam holat.

items.text: The manager was **angry with** us for being late.
items.translation: Kechikkanimiz uchun menejerning biz**dan jahli chiqdi**.

blocks.text: Predlogdan keyin fe'l kelsa, u **har doim -ing** shaklida bo'ladi: good at **cooking**, tired of **waiting**, interested in **learning**, afraid of **flying**. Bu qoida barcha predloglarga tegishli: Thank you **for coming**, **instead of** going (... o'rniga), **without** saying (... masdan), **before** leaving (105-dars), **How about** going ...? (... sak-chi?). O'zbekchada bu holatga «-ish» shakli mos keladi: pishirish**da** usta, kutish**dan** charchadim, o'rganish**ga** qiziqaman. «interested in to learn» yoki «tired of wait» — xato.

items.translation: Kamola hayvonlar rasmini chizish**ni yaxshi uddalaydi**.

items.text: We're **thinking of moving** to a bigger flat.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «afraid from» → **afraid of**; «interested to / for» → **interested in**; «married with» → **married to**; «good in maths» → **good at maths**; «angry on me» → **angry with me**; «famous with» → **famous for**; «different than» (British English da) → **different from**; «interested in to learn» → **interested in learning**; «Thank you for help me» → **Thank you for helping me**.

Sifatni yolg'iz emas, **predlogi bilan birga** yodlang — bitta so'zdek: «afraid-of», «good-at», «interested-in», «married-to». O'zbekcha qo'shimchaga qarab predlog tanlamang — u ko'pincha adashtiradi. Predlogdan keyingi fe'l — doim **-ing**.
Bog'lanish: savolda predlog oxirida (What are you afraid **of**?) — 46-dars; before / after + -ing — 105-dars; to + fe'l va -ing — 52-dars; fe'l + predlog (listen **to**, wait **for**) — 113-dars.

items: har bir sifatning o'z predlogi bor: afraid **of**, good **at**, interested **in**, keen **on**, angry **with** (kishi) / **about** (narsa), famous **for**, married **to**, different **from**;
o'zbekcha kelishik qo'shimchasi (`-dan`, `-ga`, «bilan») inglizcha predlogni aniqlamaydi;
predlogdan keyin fe'l — **-ing**: good at **swimming**, tired of **waiting**, thank you for **coming**;
savolda predlog oxirida qoladi: What are you interested **in**?

examples.title: **afraid of**, **proud of**, **full of**
examples.description: **of** bilan keladigan sifatlar: afraid / scared of (...dan qo'rqmoq), proud of (...bilan faxrlanmoq), tired of (...dan bezor bo'lmoq), jealous of, fond of, full of (...ga to'la).

sentences.text: My little brother is **afraid of** the dark.
sentences.translation: Ukam qorong'i**dan qo'rqadi**.

sentences.text: Are you **scared of** spiders? — Not really.
sentences.translation: O'rgimchaklar**dan qo'rqasizmi**? — Unchalik emas.

sentences.text: We're very **proud of** our daughter — she won a scholarship.
sentences.translation: Qizimiz **bilan** juda **faxrlanamiz** — u grant yutib oldi.

sentences.text: The bus was **full of** tourists going to the Registan.
sentences.translation: Avtobus Registonga ketayotgan sayyohlar**ga to'la** edi.

sentences.text: Bekzod is a bit **jealous of** his brother's new car.
sentences.translation: Bekzod akasining yangi mashinasi**ga** biroz **hasad qilyapti**.

sentences.text: My grandmother is very **fond of** her old garden.
sentences.translation: Buvim eski bog'i**ni** juda **yaxshi ko'radi**.

sentences.text: I'm **tired of** this rainy weather — I want some sunshine!
sentences.translation: Bu yomg'irli havo**dan bezor bo'ldim** — quyosh istayman!

sentences.text: Dilnoza wasn't **afraid of** the exam because she studied hard all year.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza imtihon**dan qo'rqmadi**, chunki yil bo'yi qattiq o'qidi.

sentences.text: Your essay is **full of** mistakes — please check it again.
sentences.translation: Inshongiz xato**ga to'la** — iltimos, qayta tekshiring.

sentences.text: Tom's parents were **proud of** him when he became a doctor.
sentences.translation: Tom shifokor bo'lganda ota-onasi u **bilan faxrlanishdi**.

examples.title: **good at**, **bad at**, **brilliant at**
examples.description: Biror ishni yaxshi yoki yomon bajarish — **good at / bad at / brilliant at / terrible at** + ot yoki **-ing**. O'zbekchada: matematika**ni** yaxshi biladi.

sentences.text: Our daughter Madina is really **good at** maths and physics.
sentences.translation: Qizimiz Madina matematika va fizika**ni** juda **yaxshi biladi**.

sentences.text: I'm **bad at** remembering names.
sentences.translation: Ismlarni eslab qolish**da ojizman**.

sentences.text: Are you **good at** cooking? — Not very, but I'm learning.
sentences.translation: Ovqat pishirish**ni yaxshi bilasizmi**? — Unchalik emas, lekin o'rganyapman.

sentences.text: James is **brilliant at** languages — he speaks five!
sentences.translation: Jeyms tillar**ga** juda **qobiliyatli** — beshta tilda gapiradi!

sentences.text: My father is **terrible at** singing, but he sings all the time.
sentences.translation: Dadam qo'shiq aytish**ni** umuman **eplay olmaydi**, lekin doim xirgoyi qiladi.

sentences.text: Aziz has always been **good at** football.
sentences.translation: Aziz har doim futbol**ni yaxshi o'ynagan**.

sentences.text: Which subjects were you **good at** at school?
sentences.translation: Maktabda qaysi fanlar**ni yaxshi o'zlashtirgansiz**?

sentences.text: Sarah isn't very **good at** getting up early.
sentences.translation: Sara erta turish**ni** unchalik **eplay olmaydi**.

sentences.text: The new manager is **good at** solving problems, so everybody likes her.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer muammolarni hal qilish**ni yaxshi biladi**, shuning uchun uni hamma yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: I've never been **good at** drawing, but my sister is an artist.
sentences.translation: Hech qachon rasm chizish**ni yaxshi uddalamaganman**, opam esa rassom.

examples.title: **interested in**, **excited about**, **famous for**
examples.description: interested **in** (...ga qiziqmoq), keen **on** (...ni yoqtirmoq), excited **about** (...dan hayajonda), famous **for** (...bilan mashhur). O'zbekcha `-ga` ni «to» deb tarjima qilmang.

sentences.text: Are you **interested in** history?
sentences.translation: Tarix**ga qiziqasizmi**?

sentences.text: Samarkand is **famous for** its beautiful blue domes.
sentences.translation: Samarqand chiroyli moviy gumbazlari **bilan mashhur**.

sentences.text: The children are really **excited about** the trip to the zoo.
sentences.translation: Bolalar hayvonot bog'iga boriladigan sayohat**dan** juda **hayajonda**.

sentences.text: My cousin isn't very **keen on** sport; he prefers books.
sentences.translation: Amakivachcham sport**ni** unchalik **yoqtirmaydi**, kitobni afzal ko'radi.

sentences.text: Margilan is **famous for** its silk.
sentences.translation: Marg'ilon ipagi **bilan mashhur**.

sentences.text: Emma became **interested in** Uzbek culture after her trip to Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Toshkentga sayohatidan keyin Emma o'zbek madaniyati**ga qiziqib qoldi**.

sentences.text: Football? I'm not **interested in** it at all.
sentences.translation: Futbolmi? Men unga umuman **qiziqmayman**.

sentences.text: We're all **excited about** Madina's wedding next month.
sentences.translation: Kelasi oy bo'ladigan Madinaning to'yi**ni** hammamiz **intiqlik bilan kutyapmiz**.

sentences.text: Is Manchester **famous for** anything apart from football?
sentences.translation: Manchester futboldan tashqari yana biror narsa **bilan mashhurmi**?

sentences.text: Bekzod is very **keen on** photography and takes his camera everywhere.
sentences.translation: Bekzod suratga olish**ga** juda **ishqiboz**, kamerasini hamma joyga olib yuradi.

examples.title: **angry with**, **worried about**, **sorry about**
examples.description: Kishiga nisbatan — angry **with** somebody, narsaga nisbatan — angry **about** something. worried **about**, upset **about**, sorry **about**.

sentences.text: Why are you **angry with** me? What have I done?
sentences.translation: Nega men**dan jahlingiz chiqdi**? Nima qildim?

sentences.text: Mum was **angry about** the broken window.
sentences.translation: Singan deraza **uchun** oyimning **jahli chiqdi**.

sentences.text: I'm a bit **worried about** my exam tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Ertangi imtihonim**dan** biroz **xavotirdaman**.

sentences.text: **Sorry about** the mess — we're decorating the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Tartibsizlik **uchun uzr** — oshxonani ta'mirlayapmiz.

sentences.text: Dilnoza was **upset about** her bad marks.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza yomon baholari**dan xafa** edi.

sentences.text: Don't be **angry with** Tom — it wasn't his fault.
sentences.translation: Tom**dan jahlingiz chiqmasin** — u aybdor emas.

sentences.text: Are you **worried about** the weather for the wedding?
sentences.translation: To'y kungi ob-havo**dan xavotirdamisiz**?

sentences.text: Please forgive me — I'm really **sorry about** last night.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, meni kechiring — kechagi voqea **uchun** chindan **uzr so'rayman**.

sentences.text: My parents are always **worried about** me when I drive at night.
sentences.translation: Kechasi mashina haydasam, ota-onam doim men **uchun xavotirlanadi**.

sentences.text: Aziz was **angry with** himself because he missed the last bus.
sentences.translation: Aziz oxirgi avtobusga ulgurmagani uchun o'zi**dan jahli chiqdi**.

examples.title: **married to**, **different from**, **ready for**
examples.description: married **to** («married with» emas), kind / nice **to**, similar **to**, different **from**, late **for**, ready **for**, responsible **for**. O'zbekcha qo'shimcha har doim ham mos kelmaydi.

sentences.text: Sarah is **married to** a doctor from Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Sara edinburglik shifokor**ga turmushga chiqqan**.

sentences.text: Everyone in the village was very **kind to** us.
sentences.translation: Qishloqdagi hamma biz**ga** juda **mehribon** edi.

sentences.text: Hurry up or we'll be **late for** the train!
sentences.translation: Shoshiling, aks holda poyezd**ga kechikamiz**!

sentences.text: Life in London is very **different from** life in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Londondagi hayot Toshkentdagi hayot**dan** juda **farq qiladi**.

sentences.text: Are you **ready for** your driving test?
sentences.translation: Haydovchilik imtihoni**ga tayyormisiz**?

sentences.text: Your phone is very **similar to** mine.
sentences.translation: Telefoningiz meniki**ga** juda **o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: Who is **responsible for** this mess in the kitchen?
sentences.translation: Oshxonadagi bu tartibsizlik **uchun** kim **javobgar**?

sentences.text: Bekzod has been **married to** Madina for ten years.
sentences.translation: Bekzod Madina **bilan** o'n yildan beri **turmush qurgan**.

sentences.text: Uzbek is quite **similar to** Turkish, so I understand a little.
sentences.translation: O'zbek tili turk tili**ga** ancha **o'xshaydi**, shuning uchun biroz tushunaman.

sentences.text: The new teacher is **nice to** everybody, but she's very strict about homework.
sentences.translation: Yangi o'qituvchi **hammaga xushmuomala**, lekin uy vazifasi masalasida juda qattiqqo'l.

examples.title: Preposition + **-ing**: tired **of waiting**
examples.description: Predlogdan keyin fe'l doim **-ing** shaklida: good at **cooking**, tired of **waiting**, interested in **learning**, thank you for **coming**, instead of **going**, without **saying**.

sentences.text: I'm **tired of waiting** — let's go without him.
sentences.translation: Kutish**dan charchadim** — usiz ketaylik.

sentences.text: Thank you **for coming** to my birthday party!
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kunimga kelgan**ingiz uchun** rahmat!

sentences.text: Madina is **interested in learning** Korean.
sentences.translation: Madina koreys tilini o'rganish**ga qiziqadi**.

sentences.text: Let's walk **instead of taking** the bus — it's a nice day.
sentences.translation: Avtobusga o'tirish **o'rniga** piyoda yuraylik — havo yaxshi.

sentences.text: He left the room **without saying** goodbye.
sentences.translation: U xayrlash**masdan** xonadan chiqib ketdi.

sentences.text: Aziz is very **good at fixing** things around the house.
sentences.translation: Aziz uydagi narsalarni tuzatish**ga** juda **usta**.

sentences.text: Are you **afraid of flying**? — A little, but I do it anyway.
sentences.translation: Samolyotda uchish**dan qo'rqasizmi**? — Biroz, lekin baribir uchaman.

sentences.text: **How about going** to the cinema tonight?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun kinoga bor**sak-chi**?

sentences.text: Bekzod is **thinking of buying** a new phone.
sentences.translation: Bekzod yangi telefon sotib olish**ni o'ylayapti**.

sentences.text: Emma apologised **for being** late and sat down quietly.
sentences.translation: Emma kechikkan**i uchun** uzr so'radi va jimgina o'tirdi.

examples.title: What are you afraid **of**? — Questions
examples.description: Savolda predlog oxirida qoladi: What are you afraid **of**? Who is she married **to**? (46-dars). Javob — qisqa.

sentences.text: What are you **afraid of**? — Snakes and high places.
sentences.translation: Nima**dan qo'rqasiz**? — Ilonlar va baland joylardan.

sentences.text: Who is Sarah **married to**? — A teacher from Glasgow.
sentences.translation: Sara kim**ga turmushga chiqqan**? — Glazgolik o'qituvchiga.

sentences.text: Which city is **famous for** its silk? — Margilan, in the Fergana Valley.
sentences.translation: Qaysi shahar ipagi **bilan mashhur**? — Farg'ona vodiysidagi Marg'ilon.

sentences.text: Which sport is your brother **good at**? — Tennis — he plays every weekend.
sentences.translation: Akangiz qaysi sport turi**ni yaxshi o'ynaydi**? — Tennisni — har dam olish kunlari o'ynaydi.

sentences.text: Why is Mum **angry with** us? — Because we didn't clean our room.
sentences.translation: Nega oyimning biz**dan jahli chiqdi**? — Chunki xonamizni yig'ishtirmadik.

sentences.text: What kind of music are you **interested in**? — Mostly jazz.
sentences.translation: Qanday musiqa**ga qiziqasiz**? — Asosan jazzga.

sentences.text: Is Dilnoza still **worried about** her job? — Yes, she's **afraid of losing** it.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza hali ham ishi**dan xavotirdami**? — Ha, uni yo'qotib qo'yish**dan qo'rqadi**.

sentences.text: How is London **different from** Tashkent? — It's much colder and wetter.
sentences.translation: London Toshkent**dan** nimasi bilan **farq qiladi**? — Ancha sovuqroq va namroq.

sentences.text: Is everyone **tired of** studying? — Yes, let's take a break.
sentences.translation: Hamma o'qish**dan charchadimi**? — Ha, tanaffus qilaylik.

sentences.text: What was everyone so **excited about**? — Bekzod's news — he's getting married!
sentences.translation: Hamma nima**dan** bunchalik **hayajonda** edi? — Bekzodning yangiligidan — u uylanyapti!

examples.title: Mixed: I'm **good at** ..., but not **good at** ...
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: tasdiq ↔ inkor va turli «sifat + predlog» juftliklari; predlogdan keyin ot yoki **-ing**.

sentences.text: I'm **good at** maths, but I'm not very **good at** spelling.
sentences.translation: Matematika**ni yaxshi bilaman**, lekin imlo**da** unchalik **kuchli emasman**.

sentences.text: Tom isn't **afraid of** dogs, but he's **terrified of** cats!
sentences.translation: Tom itlar**dan qo'rqmaydi**, lekin mushuklar**dan** juda **qo'rqadi**!

sentences.text: My sister is **interested in** fashion; I'm more **interested in** cars.
sentences.translation: Opam moda**ga qiziqadi**, men esa ko'proq mashinalar**ga qiziqaman**.

sentences.text: Bekzod wasn't **ready for** the test, so he was **nervous about** the results.
sentences.translation: Bekzod test**ga tayyor emas** edi, shuning uchun natijalar**dan xavotirda** edi.

sentences.text: Aziz's new flat is very **different from** his old one — it's much bigger.
sentences.translation: Azizning yangi kvartirasi eskisi**dan** juda **farq qiladi** — ancha katta.

sentences.text: Thank you **for helping** me — I couldn't do it **without** you.
sentences.translation: Menga yordam berganingiz **uchun** rahmat — siz**siz** buni uddalay olmasdim.

sentences.text: Madina isn't **jealous of** her sister; she's **proud of** her.
sentences.translation: Madina opasi**ga hasad qilmaydi**, aksincha, u **bilan faxrlanadi**.

sentences.text: We're **bored with** the same old food — let's try that new restaurant.
sentences.translation: Bir xil ovqat**dan zerikdik** — anavi yangi restoranni sinab ko'raylik.

sentences.text: Sarah is **fond of** her students, and they're very **fond of** her too.
sentences.translation: Sara o'quvchilari**ni yaxshi ko'radi**, ular ham uni juda yaxshi ko'rishadi.

sentences.text: **Instead of complaining about** the weather, let's enjoy the snow!
sentences.translation: Ob-havo**dan shikoyat qilish o'rniga** qordan zavqlanaylik!
